title: Files and Folders
summary: Create, copy, move and delete files and folders.
intro:
Your sandbox is a little messy.
In this lesson you will build folders, make files, copy them, rename them and clean up.
Everything happens inside your sandbox, so your real files are safe from mistakes.
outro: Great job! You can now organize files like a pro.

steps.instruction: Make a new folder called projects.
hints: The command to make a directory is mkdir.
steps.explain: mkdir means 'make directory'. A directory is the same thing as a folder.

steps.instruction: Make the folders projects/game/levels in ONE command.
hints: mkdir has an option that creates the parent folders too: -p
steps.explain: mkdir -p creates every missing folder on the path. Without -p, mkdir fails if 'game' does not exist yet.
touch creates an empty file, or updates the time of a file that already exists.

hints: cp means copy: cp FROM TO
steps.explain: cp copies a file. The original stays. To copy a whole folder, use cp -r.

hints: In the terminal, renaming is the same as moving: mv
steps.explain: mv moves OR renames. mv a.txt b.txt renames. mv a.txt folder/ moves it into the folder.

steps.instruction: Clean up: delete junk.txt and the empty folder empty_box.
hints: rm deletes a file. rmdir deletes an EMPTY folder.
Type: rm junk.txt   and then:   rmdir empty_box
steps.explain: Careful: rm does NOT use a trash can. The file is gone forever. Always check twice before you press Enter.
